Name: Darkroom Portrait Shop - SVE Add-On
Author: AgentLyoko
Description:
[b][center][i]1.6 SPOILERS WITH THIS MOD! Do NOT proceed unless you are willing to be spoiled.[/i][/center][/b]
This is an add-on pack for my mod Darkroom Portrait Shop mod, allowing you to purchase or obtain the SVE portraits added with Stardew Valley Expanded. Obtaining them follows the same system as the original mod - in this mod, select one of the following options and the portraits will behave accordingly:

[list]
[*]Immediate: Obtain the ability to buy the portraits directly at 8 hearts with that villager. One per day, 30,000 gold.
[*]One time: Give a villager with 8 hearts or more a portrait ticket to receive a free portrait two days later. Thereafter, you can either give them a portrait ticket to obtain another or buy one per day of that villager at Haley's Darkroom shop. Price varies based on hearts with Haley.
[*]Immersion (default): Give a villager with 8 hearts or more a portrait ticket and a couple days later they will send you a mail with a free portrait. Price of the portrait ticket will depend on the config set in Darkroom Portrait Shop itself.
[/list]
This add-on pack covers Sophia, Claire, Olivia, Victor, the Wizard (Magnus), Lance, and Apples. If more are added into SVE, until this mod is updated those portraits will not be covered.

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url] for permission to compat Darkroom Portrait Shop with this mod!

Downloads.Description: Fixes an error that renders the Wizard's/Magnus's portrait as unobtainable with the portrait ticket with SpaceCore installed.
